title: Peaceful Revolution
audience: English men in port towns who already know they were not asked

voice.accent: South East England, not BBC, not mockney
voice.pace: measured, not salesy, not a sermon

look.grade: cold Channel light, wet tarmac, ferry white, brick, no teal-and-orange ad grade
forbid: balaclava crowd as hero or villain

shots.visual: Dawn over the Port of Dover. Empty car deck of a ferry. No faces yet. Wind, gulls, a chain clinks.

shots.vo: Repair needs a civilization that still trades.
shots.visual: Lorries rolling onto a berth. A welder in a shed. Hands, not banners.

shots.vo: That promise is Good News. It is closed to wreckers.
shots.visual: White cliffs, working harbour, one ship leaving. Not a holiday postcard — a lung.
A terrace street in Dover. Curtain twitch. Council letter on a doormat. Cut.

shots.vo: A vote is not consent. A crowd is not an owner. A category is not a man.
shots.visual: Ballot box, then a packed high street, then a single man's face in a cafe window — three cuts, one sentence each.

shots.vo: Newton mapped reality. Locke is an ancestor, not scripture.
shots.visual: Principia page, apple not required. Chalk, orbit, a workshop bench with tools. No costume drama.

shots.vo: Lilburne: even the king is under the law. That is the pride. Not a blood-licence to take.
shots.super: EVEN THE KING IS UNDER THE LAW
shots.visual: A front door, a latch, a man's house. Then the port again. No crowd claiming a street.
shots.camera: close on latch, cut to harbour

shots.vo: The cabinet takes without asking. That is theft with a letterhead.
shots.visual: HMRC envelope, PAYE slip, Whitehall facade at a distance. No MP close-up.

shots.vo: Saturday the papers cried blockade. Kent Police nicked nobody. A headline is not a judgment.
shots.visual: A newspaper spinning a panic headline, then Kent Police statement text on a phone: no arrests, traffic flowing, dispersed by midday. Port approaches moving.
shots.camera: insert phone, then wide of moving traffic

shots.vo: Do not do to others what they would not want done to them. No victim, no crime. No agent stands above the law.
shots.visual: The ten lines do not all fit. Three land as type over tarmac and water. No choir.

shots.vo: Trade is free or it is not trade. Error is not evil. Refusing to correct it is.
shots.super: TRADE IS FREE OR IT IS NOT TRADE
shots.visual: Ferry departing. Crane. A man walking home down a side street, hat on, face visible.
